Create the following Go files for the plane-cli project. Follow the same patterns used in existing commands.

Read `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/label/label.go` first to understand the pattern, then create:

1. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/comment/comment.go` - CRUD for issue comments
   - API path: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{issue_id}/comments/`
   - Needs --issue flag for all commands to specify the work item ID
   - Table columns: ID, ACTOR(actor), BODY(comment_html)
   - Create: --issue (required), --body (required, maps to comment_html in JSON)
   - Update: <comment-id> arg, --body
   - Delete: <comment-id> arg
   - Get: <comment-id> arg
   - List: lists all comments for --issue

2. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/link/link.go` - CRUD for issue links
   - API path: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{issue_id}/links/`
   - Needs --issue flag for all commands
   - Table columns: ID, TITLE(title), URL(url)
   - Create: --issue (required), --title (required), --url (required)
   - Update: <link-id> arg, --title, --url
   - Delete: <link-id> arg
   - Get: <link-id> arg
   - List: lists all links for --issue

3. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/activity/activity.go` - Read-only activity
   - API path: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{issue_id}/activities/`
   - Needs --issue flag
   - Table columns: ID, FIELD(field), VERB(verb), OLD_VALUE(old_value), NEW_VALUE(new_value)
   - List: all activities for --issue
   - Get: <activity-id> arg

All use their own package name. Import paths:
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/api
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/cmdutil
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/output

Export: `func NewCmd(f *cmdutil.Factory) *cobra.Command`
